about_the_game:
Desktop Farm is a placement game located at the bottom of the screen that will not affect your daily learning and work. Purchase resources and machinery, raise small animals, grow crops, automate collection Complete the order to earn coins and expand your farm. Manage your farm well to avoid monster attacks, and you are the best farmer!

Planting crops:

Plant various crops, purchase seeds from stores and plant them in your newly cultivated farmland. This is also an important source of food for livestock farming.

Building an electrical system:

Drones used for automation require energy supply. Build wind turbines and charging towers to power drones!

Automated operation using drones:

Deploy cute drones to assist in resource collection and combat. You can also change the operating mode of the drone through commands.

Breeding animals:

Buying animals in stores and raising them until they reach adulthood is one of the important sources of income. Animals raised are vulnerable to attacks from monsters, so be sure to protect them well!

Order system:

There are various orders on the order panel, complete them to earn income and expand your farm!
